Rising: 90 minutes
Cooking: ~20 minutes|difficulty=3 }} {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Bread|Bread]] This is a yeast dough bun that is stuffed with a meat filling and steamed until cooked. ==Ingredients== ===Bun filling=== *8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounce]]s (225 g) shredded cooked [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] or [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] *½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Barbecue Sauce|barbecue sauce]] *1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]] *1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|cooking oil]] *1 tbsp granulated white [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]] *1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Teriyaki Sauce|Teriyaki sauce]] *1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] garlic [[Cookbook:Chili Paste|chili sauce]] *¼ tsp [[Cookbook:Five Spice Powder|five spice powder]] *¼ tsp toasted [[Cookbook:Sesame Oil|sesame oil]] ===Steamed buns=== *1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]s warm water (95°F / 35°C) *3 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] (or 1 packet) active dry [[Cookbook:Yeast|yeast]] *3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] granulated white [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|sugar]] *4 cups white bread [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]] *2 tbsp cooking [[Cookbook:Oil|oil]] *1 tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]] *½ tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] ==Procedure== ===Bun filling=== #Place all ingredients in [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]]. #Process until ingredients are blended and chopped fine. ===Steamed buns=== #Stir yeast and 1 tablespoon of sugar into 1½ cups of warm water (95°F / 35°C.). Let stand for 15 minutes. #Mix yeast water, 2 more tablespoons of sugar, flour, cooking oil, baking powder, and salt in mixing bowl. #Stir until [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]] forms. [[Cookbook:Kneading|Knead]] dough for 10 minutes. #Allow dough to rise in a warm place for 1½ hours. #Punch dough down and divide into 12 pieces. #Roll each piece of dough into a ball, then flatten with [[Cookbook:Rolling Pin|rolling pin]] into a 6-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (15 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) circle. #Place 1 tablespoon of meat filling in center of each flattened piece of dough. #Lift the edges of the flattened dough up around the filling and bring edges together. Pinch edges closed to form filled bun. #Place buns on [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment paper]]. Allow to rise in a warm place 1 hour, until doubled in size. #[[Cookbook:Steaming|Steam]] buns in a steamer over boiling water for 20 minutes. #Remove from steamer. When cool enough to handle, remove parchment paper from bottom. #Serve warm. ==Notes, tips, and variations== * Keep leftovers refrigerated. Reheat in microwave for 30–45 seconds. steps.text: Place all ingredients in food processor.
Process until ingredients are blended and chopped fine.
Stir yeast and 1 tablespoon of sugar into 1½ cups of warm water (95°F / 35°C.). Let stand for 15 minutes.
Mix yeast water, 2 more tablespoons of sugar, flour, cooking oil, baking powder, and salt in mixing bowl.
Stir until dough forms. Knead dough for 10 minutes.
Allow dough to rise in a warm place for 1½ hours.
Punch dough down and divide into 12 pieces.
Roll each piece of dough into a ball, then flatten with rolling pin into a 6-inch (15 cm) circle.
Place 1 tablespoon of meat filling in center of each flattened piece of dough.
Lift the edges of the flattened dough up around the filling and bring edges together. Pinch edges closed to form filled bun.
Place buns on parchment paper. Allow to rise in a warm place 1 hour, until doubled in size.
Steam buns in a steamer over boiling water for 20 minutes.
Remove from steamer. When cool enough to handle, remove parchment paper from bottom.
Serve warm.
